name: How do I choose the right contractor to finish my garage?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor to finish my garage?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should choose a general remodeling contractor when your project involves multiple intersecting tasks like framing, drywall, electrical, and finish trim rather than just basic hanging. An experienced general contractor coordinates trade sequencing so electrical rough-ins are inspected before drywalling begins, avoiding costly wall teardowns. With an owner-operated company like HH Remodeling LLC, Abraham Becerra directly manages the job site, ensuring carpentry, drywall taping, and paint match the same quality standards as the rest of your home's interior.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed finish contractor who handles carpentry, drywall, and trade coordination directly, ensuring fire codes and build sequences are met.
